description: A comprehensive overhaul of Meridian Health's visual identity — from typography and color to a full component library used across digital and print touchpoints. The goal was to unify 12 regional sub-brands under a single, accessible design language without erasing local character.

Designed and produced an interactive in-store environment for Forma Studio's flagship New York location. The installation blends physical product displays with reactive digital surfaces, creating a seamless narrative that guides customers through the brand story.

A data-driven annual report that translates complex financial performance into clear, compelling visual narratives. Custom infographics, editorial photography direction, and a print-ready layout system were developed in tandem with the digital web version.

Redefining the annual report through a fully responsive digital experience. We moved beyond static PDF layouts to create a narrative-driven platform that adapts from billboard-scale displays to mobile screens, showcasing the year’s research and impact with dynamic typography and motion-rich data visualizations.
